description: Estimated Dwelling Stock is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). Estimates of dwelling stock, including additions and removals, created by the Australian Bureau of Statistics. The tables also include information on dwelling type such as house, townhouse or apartment. Data can be downloaded in Excel format (XLSX) for Statistical Areas Level 2, 3, and 4 (SA2, SA3, and SA4), Greater Capital City Statistical Areas (GCCSA), and States and Territories. Coverage is Australia, 2016 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
